name: Suicidal Ideation Attributes Scale (SIDAS)
construct: Recent suicidal ideation severity and attributes
rights: Australian National University states: No permission required — please cite reference.

items.text: In the past month, how often have you had thoughts about suicide?
In the past month, how much control have you had over these thoughts?
In the past month, how close have you come to making a suicide attempt?
In the past month, to what extent have you felt tormented by thoughts about suicide?
In the past month, how much have thoughts about suicide interfered with your ability to carry out daily activities, such as work, household tasks or social activities?

scoring.method: Sum five items after reverse-scoring controllability (item 2: 10 becomes 0 through 0 becomes 10). If item 1 is 0 (Never), remaining items are skipped and total is 0.

safety_note: SIDAS is a research measure of suicidal ideation severity. It must not be used by this prototype to declare an individual safe or unsafe or to calculate an individual suicide probability. Any endorsement of suicidal ideation, and especially proximity to an attempt, requires direct human assessment under the applicable approved safety protocol.
